model_annotation: The plot displays three time series indices from 2016 to 2024, representing economic policy areas: "Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt" (overall economic policy, black line), "Finanzpolitik" (financial policy, blue line), and "Handelspolitik" (trade policy, purple line). The x-axis is a linear scale spanning from 2016 to 2024, with tick labels at two-year intervals (2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024). The y-axis on the left, labeled "Index," ranges from 0 to 1,000 with major tick marks every 100 units, and is used for the black and blue lines. The y-axis on the right, also labeled "Index," ranges from 0 to 9,000 with major tick marks every 1,000 units, and is used for the purple line. The black line starts near 50 in 2016, fluctuates between 50 and 150 until 2020, spikes to approximately 500 in mid-2020, then declines to around 100 by 2022, remains relatively stable until 2024, and then rises sharply to nearly 700 by the end of the period. The blue line follows a similar pattern, starting near 50, peaking at approximately 450 in mid-2020, and then dropping to around 100 before rising sharply to about 650 by the end. The purple line, scaled on the right axis, remains near 0 until mid-2020, rises slightly to around 1,000, drops back to near 0, and then increases dramatically from 2024 onwards, reaching approximately 8,500 by the end of the period. All lines are solid and without markers.
